Preserve the original composition, element positions, object sizes, product details, camera angle, perspective relationship, color palette, and overall exposure of the image. Only refine the lighting logic, shadow direction, contact shadows, local perspective occlusion, material reflections, and edge integration.

Keep the image bright, clean, and commercially lit. Do not darken the overall scene, do not reduce exposure, do not add heavy shadows, do not create a low-key or moody lighting effect. Maintain the original brightness level, soft highlights, natural midtones, and clear product visibility.

Adjust the light and shadow only where necessary to make all elements feel naturally integrated into the same scene. Match the existing main light direction, ambient fill light, reflected light, and shadow softness. Contact shadows should be soft, realistic, and subtle, only used to strengthen grounding and spatial depth.

Correct local perspective alignment, overlapping relationships, edge transitions, small artifacts, unnatural cutout edges, inconsistent reflections, and material mismatch at pixel level. Refine projection, reflection, transparency, gloss, matte texture, and surface interaction according to the existing lighting environment.

The final image should look like a native professional commercial product photograph with unified lighting, natural perspective, clean materials, seamless integration, balanced brightness, rich but not heavy shadows, and no sense of AI-generated inconsistency.
